title: dactylorhiza majalis var. occidentalis
intro: Dactylorhiza majalis var. occidentalis, commonly known as Western Marsh Orchid, is a subspecies of orchid native to western North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as respiratory issues and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Western Marsh Orchid include astringent, demulcent, and expectorant effects, making it a potential treatment for coughs, colds, and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
